description_for_human: Specialized Bikes MCP Server lists in-stock gravel bikes and designs made-to-order custom builds.
description_for_model: Use for the specialized bicycles catalog: list in-stock gravel & adventure bikes and design made-to-order custom bicycle builds. Both tools render interactive widgets; design_custom_bikes is a long-running MCP task.

functions.name: list_gravel_bikes
functions.description: List in-stock specialized gravel & adventure bikes. Responds after about 20 seconds and renders the gravel bikes widget.

functions.name: design_custom_bikes
functions.description: Generate a set of made-to-order custom bicycle builds. Long-running MCP task that returns a task id immediately and renders the custom builds widget.

tools.name: list_gravel_bikes
tools.description: List in-stock specialized gravel & adventure bikes. Responds after about 20 seconds and renders the gravel bikes widget.

tools.name: design_custom_bikes
tools.description: Generate a set of made-to-order custom bicycle builds. This is a long-running operation (about 300 seconds) and runs as an MCP task: it returns a task id immediately and the result is retrieved via tasks/result once complete. Renders the custom builds widget.

_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Spinning up the custom build workshop…
